name: Vegetation
overview: Scripture reveals that vegetation was created by God on the third day of creation, as the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed, and fruit trees bearing fruit according to their kinds. This vegetation was purposefully made not only to beautify the earth but also to provide food for mankind and all living creatures, as God granted every herb and fruit-bearing tree for sustenance. Before vegetation grew, there was no rain or man to till the ground, highlighting God's sovereign provision and timing in establishing plant life.
